# Mobile Tyre Vans — Comprehensive AI Context File

> This file provides detailed context about Mobile Tyre Vans (MTV) for AI language models, search assistants, and crawlers. Last updated: 2026.

---

## About Mobile Tyre Vans

Mobile Tyre Vans (MTV) is the UK's leading specialist in custom mobile tyre van conversions. We design, build, and deliver fully-equipped mobile tyre vans from our in-house workshop at Unit 1, Example Business Park, Your Town, AA1 1AA.

Our mission is to empower mobile business owners with the tools, training, and support they need to succeed. Every van we build is a complete mobile workshop — professionally converted, tested, and ready to earn from day one.

We serve entrepreneurs, ex-tradespeople, and existing fleet operators who want to start or grow a mobile tyre fitting business anywhere in the United Kingdom.

---

## Products & Packages

### Van Conversions
We convert panel vans into professional mobile tyre-fitting businesses. Base vehicles include:
- **Ford Transit** (L3H3 — most popular)
- **Mercedes Sprinter**
- **Volkswagen Crafter**
- **Vauxhall Movano**
- **Iveco Daily**
- **Nissan Interstar**
- **Citroën Relay**
- **Peugeot Boxer**

Customers may supply their own van or source one through MTV.

### Equipment Packages

**Bronze Package** — Entry-level kit
Ideal for operators starting out. Includes the core equipment needed to fit tyres professionally and legally.

**Silver Package** — Mid-range professional kit
Upgraded tools, higher-spec compressor, and additional equipment for operators who want to handle a higher volume of jobs.

**Gold Package** — Premium specification
Top-of-the-range equipment for high-volume operators and those targeting fleets. Includes advanced tools, better racking, and premium compressor.

### What Every Conversion Includes
- Professional tyre fitting equipment installed and secured
- Heavy-duty racking and storage system
- Compressor mounted and fully wired
- Pre-delivery inspection and testing
- Nationwide UK delivery to your door
- Optional: professional vehicle livery and branding by our in-house design team

---

## Finance

MTV is an FCA authorised credit broker. We can introduce customers to a panel of lenders for:
- **Hire Purchase (HP)** — own the van outright at the end of the term
- **Lease agreements** — lower monthly payments with a balloon option

Representative example: £35,000 cash price, £3,500 deposit, amount of credit £31,500, 36 monthly payments, 12% APR representative. Total amount payable varies by term and deposit.

Finance is subject to status. Terms and conditions apply. We are a credit broker, not a lender.

Use the free finance calculator at: https://www.mobiletyrevans.co.uk/finance

---

## Training

**REACT Motorway Certification**
Recovery Equipment And Carriageway Training (REACT) is the industry-standard legal requirement for operating on UK motorways and high-speed roads. Essential for insurance and legal compliance.

REACT modules include:
- Highway Code Compliance (2 hours)
- Vehicle Positioning — safe techniques on live carriageways (3 hours)
- Risk Assessment (2 hours)
- Emergency Procedures (2 hours)
- Equipment Safety (1.5 hours)
- Practical Assessment (3 hours)

**Tyre Fitting Training**
Professional tyre fitting training for mobile environments:
- Tyre Technology & Construction (2 hours)
- Mobile Fitting Techniques (4 hours)
- Wheel Balancing (2 hours)
- Puncture Repair (1.5 hours)
- TPMS Systems (2 hours)
- Customer Service Excellence (1.5 hours)

**Status:** Training programme is in development. Contact us to register your interest.

---

## The Business Opportunity

Mobile tyre fitting is one of the UK's fastest growing small business sectors. Key facts:
- Clients in London reporting daily turnovers of up to £1,200
- 40% year-on-year growth in demand
- Low overheads: no shop premises, no rates, no large staff
- High-ticket repeat business: a single job can be £100–£400; customers return every 2–3 years
- Consumer demand for at-home services is structural and accelerating

**Who is this for?**
- Ex-tradespeople looking for better margins
- Entrepreneurs seeking a proven, low-overhead business model
- Existing fleet operators wanting to add a mobile tyre bolt-on

**Business in a Box includes:**
1. Fully converted mobile tyre van
2. Access to MTV's established tyre supplier network at trade pricing
3. Professional SEO-optimised website built for your brand and area

## FAQ

**Q: How much does a mobile tyre van conversion cost?**
A: Pricing varies depending on the base van, equipment package, and optional upgrades selected. Use the online configurator at https://www.mobiletyrevans.co.uk/configurator/van for an instant price. Finance is available from 12% APR representative.

**Q: Do you offer nationwide delivery?**
A: Yes. We deliver completed van conversions across the whole of the United Kingdom. All vans are fully built, tested, and inspected at our UK workshop before delivery.

**Q: Can I use my own van?**
A: Yes. We can convert a customer-supplied van. Alternatively, we can source a suitable base vehicle.

**Q: What equipment is included?**
A: All packages include tyre fitting equipment, compressor, racking, and storage. The exact specification depends on whether you choose Bronze, Silver, or Gold. The online configurator shows each package in detail.

**Q: Is finance available?**
A: Yes. We are an FCA authorised credit broker. We offer hire purchase and leasing through a panel of lenders. Use the finance calculator at https://www.mobiletyrevans.co.uk/finance to see indicative monthly payments.

**Q: Do you offer training?**
A: We are developing in-house REACT motorway certification and professional tyre fitting training. Contact us to register your interest: https://www.mobiletyrevans.co.uk/training

**Q: How long does the conversion take?**
A: Build times vary. Contact us for current lead times. Once complete, we deliver directly to you.

**Q: Where are you based?**
A: Unit 1, Example Business Park, Your Town, AA1 1AA. We build all vans in-house at this facility and deliver UK-wide.
